summary: Clearmind Medicine Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the grant of a new U.S. patent (No. 12,357,590) titled 'BINGE BEHAVIOR REGULATORS' by the USPTO. This is a routine intellectual property update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change. No transaction or event triggering a special-situations classification is present.
